ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity (white/light-gray) to low-intensity (black/dark-gray) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity pixels occupy the central and inferior medial regions. High-intensity pixels are localized to the superior-lateral quadrants. Significant high-frequency black mottling is present at the transition boundaries on both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with an approximate internal pixel angle of 25 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the superior boundary, with increased pixel-amplitude and jaggedness at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: General convex curvature across both lobes with a slight concave recurve observed at the extreme distal margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: White, circular textured pixel clusters indicative of scarring/colonization are visible on both the left and right distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct, vertically-aligned, high-intensity linear tracks (rake marks) are visible on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two prominent parallel vertical white scars on the right ventral lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Specific high-density mottling pattern (dark spots on white) on the superior edge of the left lobe.
